## About
McKinney Spine & Wellness is a chiropractic office on W Virginia St in McKinney, led by chiropractor Shane Cowan. He is a strong believer in comprehensive multidisciplinary care and has firm relationships with medical doctors, pain management specialists, behavioral health specialists and orthopedic surgeons.
We treat all ages, as young as newborns. That includes car accident and work injuries, sports and school injuries, expectant mothers and physical rehabilitation, along with conditions like headaches, sciatica and disc problems.
One patient wrote that they were put at ease from the start and that every question was answered without medical jargon. Patients rate us 4.9 from 112 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Adjustments: Dr Cowan uses a variety of techniques, including Diversified, Thompson Drop, Activator and Myofascial Release.
- Massage services: Massage that sits alongside your chiropractic care. One reviewer plans to come back for the massage services.
- Electric Muscle Stimulation: Offered as part of treatment. One new patient received EMS therapy alongside an adjustment.
- Cold Laser Therapy: One of the therapies offered in the office.
- X-Rays (in house): X-rays are taken right here in the office, so you don't have to go elsewhere.
- Automobile accident claims: Hurt in an automobile accident? Call to make an appointment and we can help guide you through your claim.
- Workers compensation: Injured on the job? Dr Cowan is very knowledgeable with workers compensation and can help guide you in the right direction with your claim.

## FAQ
Q: What insurance do you work with?
A: We work with most insurance plans, including Medicare, as well as auto insurance, workers compensation, attorneys and cash plans.

Q: Can I fill out paperwork before my first visit?
A: Yes. You can fill out the new patient forms from our website and bring them with you to your appointment.

Q: What conditions do you treat?
A: Just a few include headaches and migraines, joint pain and arthritis, allergies, TMJ, sciatica and disc problems, nerve problems, bulging or herniated discs, and numbness, tingling or sharp pains.
